visualCharacteristics.colorScheme: light-grey boxes on a full-width section photo
visualCharacteristics.layout: 3 equal boxes in a row (stacked on mobile, 2 per row from 600px); exactly 4 boxes share one row from 900px; each: label heading, very large centred number, bold unit line and small descriptive text; no images

contentPattern: One row per stat, one cell each: label (h3), large number paragraph (e.g. "0.20"), bold unit line (e.g. "t CO2e per ton"), description paragraph(s)
